A mistaken name that does not reliably identify one actual individual is not a search through possible matches. This spell creates no mark, tracking token, map, teleport permission, ongoing detection or proof of life from an absent bearing. Repeated legal paid casts can provide new snapshots subject to the same limits. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. operational.targets: Self; choose one exact known canonical factionId.
operational.duration: Instantaneous private institutional inquiry
operational.resolution: No roll. Privately learn one actual current major institutional objective of the chosen faction. No physical representative, positive reputation, membership, Faction Seal permission, geographic distance or planar anchor is required.
operational.effect: A qualifying objective is a concrete established goal pursued or prioritized by the institution or its recognized governing authority, such as securing a trade route, recovering a stolen archive or removing a named governor from office. A member’s private wish, reputation inference or the Director’s preferred plot is not an institutional objective. If several objectives are genuinely coequal, the Director records one stable priority selection while that institutional state remains materially unchanged. Equivalent repeat casts across casters/rephrasing do not rotate through hidden coequal goals. Report No Current Major Objective only for genuine established absence; undefined or specifically protected institutional information reports Indeterminate. Independently readable portions of a meaningful goal may be stated while protected details remain Indeterminate, without identifying which ward or hidden record caused the limit.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Protection of one leader’s personal information does not erase an independently established institutional objective, and a protected private plan does not become institutional merely to evade protection. A subfaction must have its own actual canonical identity to be selected separately; invented subdivisions are not extra inquiries. The spell does not directly reveal an operational plan, member list, exact locations, timetable, secret agents, resources or every subordinate objective. A goal can naturally mention a readable subject as necessary to make it concrete, but supplies no additional dossier. It changes neither reputation nor faction intent and forces no action. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and one current major faction objective. CONFLICT RULING: Self abstract informational casting replaces raw 60-foot metadata. sourceCatalogRecord.name: Faction Spy

operational.targets: Self; choose one specifically identifiable headquarters of one exact canonical faction and the qualifying room/area to observe.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Select the exact faction and a specific established headquarters belonging to it. Institutional identification can suffice without street coordinates, such as the faction’s established central headquarters in a named city. A faction name alone cannot discover an unknown or secret HQ. Select one specific named room/common area of that HQ you know, or use its established primary common/operations area. If no such area is established, use the ordinary main interior space nearest its primary public/working entrance. No reputation, membership, Faction Seal or special infrastructure is required.
operational.effect: Create a fixed nonphysical observation point at the center of the selected room/area’s ordinarily usable interior space, at an ordinary standing observer’s eye height. If that point is inside solid matter, use the nearest open point within the same selected space; the Director resolves equal choices with a fixed neutral spatial order. No point outside that space or inside a secret adjacent room is substituted. If the selected HQ does not exist, is not the identified HQ, no longer belongs to the chosen faction at resolution, or has no valid viewpoint, receive no feed. The observation feed operates at any distance, but only while the selected physical viewpoint and caster are on the same plane. If they are not, no remote sight or hearing is received and the spell does not identify plane separation as the reason. For the duration while this feed is available, receive ordinary sight in all directions and hearing from the point alongside your local senses. Local light, obscurity, walls and sound conditions apply; no enhanced senses are granted. Blindness suppresses remote sight and Deafened suppresses remote hearing. Subject/area Divination protections filter only information within their actual scope.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: One active Faction Spy point per caster; successful recasting replaces it. The point stays fixed in the selected physical room/site. Later institutional relocation or ownership change does not relocate that point or choose a new HQ; an actually mobile structure carries its own room and point normally. Maintain a same-plane connection to the point; plane separation suppresses both feeds without ending or pausing the spell, and return restores current information only. Ordinary obstruction, suppression and destruction of the room do not select a replacement room or refresh the duration. This ongoing magic has no body or HP and can be detected/ended only by an effect whose actual permissions apply. It cannot move through rooms, search, remotely interact, grant attacks/casting/line of effect, issue credentials, alter reputation, authorize entry or create a recording/replay. All-direction observation from one fixed point does not allow moving the viewpoint. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F and one minute observing HQ activities. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational receiver and any-distance same-plane reach replace raw 30-foot metadata; rangeFeet 0 denotes Self, not the remote distance. NEW: no concentration, exact institutional HQ/room selection and simultaneous ordinary sight/hearing. Exact completion adds one point per caster, a deterministic usable-room viewpoint, same-plane suppression/recovery and post-resolution site continuity rather than moving with institutional ownership.

operational.targets: Self; one specifically declared course of action you intend to begin within the next minute, judged against one concrete goal for you, your party or another identified beneficiary.
operational.duration: Instantaneous forecast; evaluates the 30 minutes following the proposed beginning of the course.
operational.resolution: No roll. State the course, its intended beginning within 60 elapsed seconds of resolution, and its concrete goal or interest before receiving the answer. The Director privately answers exactly Yes, No or Unclear using the most likely material consequences under current circumstances during the 30 minutes following that proposed beginning.
operational.effect: Yes means the course is more likely than not to materially advance the stated goal. No means it is more likely than not to materially harm, frustrate or move away from that goal. Unclear means favorable and unfavorable consequences are materially balanced/mixed, the course is too contingent to favor either result, or information necessary for the judgment is undefined or protected. A course with no material effect on the stated goal is Unclear. Good/bad refers to this practical goal, not moral alignment or the Director’s preferred plot; a dangerous action that advances the goal can be Yes. Uncertainty alone is not grounds for Unclear when current evidence materially favors Yes or No.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: This predicts rather than fixes destiny. Later voluntary choices, new events and die results can change the outcome. It reveals neither future dice nor a full causal explanation, hidden actor identities, room contents or a guaranteed plan. Materially equivalent course/goal inquiries under unchanged circumstances return the same answer across casters, rephrasing and repeated casts. Genuinely different courses/goals or materially changed circumstances may yield different answers. No additional daily cap applies. The answer does not identify which protection or missing fact caused Unclear. The one-minute beginning requirement is an inquiry condition, not a sustained magical deadline or obligation forcing the caster to act. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and Yes/No/Unclear outcome inquiry. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational mode replaces raw 30-foot metadata. NEW: concrete goal, beginning within one minute, 30-minute forecast horizon, stable equivalent inquiries and useful likelihood standard. Exact completion anchors the horizon to the declared beginning and treats materially neutral outcomes as Unclear.

sourceCatalogRecord.name: Resonance Sight

operational.targets: Self; view ordinarily visible creatures and objects within 30 feet, on the same plane and in line of effect.
operational.duration: 1 round, no concentration. Ends at the caster's first future regular-start marker in initiative, or 6 elapsed seconds after application outside initiative. Preserve that virtual phase/absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and death; an already-passed start does not count.
operational.resolution: No roll or additional scanning Action. Privately perceive a colored aura for each eligible subject with an actual RP pool. The aura lets you read that subject's exact current RP amount and updates as the amount changes during the spell.
operational.effect: Its color is your intuitive private visual encoding of the number, not an externally standardized palette. A defined pool at 0 RP reads as a dim/colorless zero aura. A subject with no defined RP pool has no aura. An effect preventing the read likewise supplies no readable aura and does not identify its own protection; the absence of a readable aura therefore is not proof that a pool does not exist.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.
operational.limitations: You learn only current RP, not maximum RP, Dissonance, Refrain, class, charges, spell repertoire, HP, recovery history or another resource. A missing pool is never invented as 0 RP. The aura is visible only to you, emits no real light, and does not reveal Invisible/Hidden creatures or satisfy vision through obscurity or total cover. Losing ordinary visibility, range or line of effect removes the current read without freezing a falsely current value. No RP, transfer permission, energy source, detectable public light or resource reset is created. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,30-foot information area and colored RP auras for1round. NEW: Self casting origin, exact-current-RP private encoding, actual-zero distinction, dynamic ordinary-visibility predicate and no pool invention. No concentration is added.

sourceCatalogRecord.name: Resonance Sight (Greater)

operational.targets: Self; magical effects within 60 feet on your plane and in line of effect.
operational.duration: Instantaneous private snapshot
operational.resolution: No roll. Detect every currently existing qualifying magical effect with a readable portion in the area. Ordinary non-solid visual concealment and lack of mundane visibility, including Hidden/Invisible status, do not hide the effect itself. Solid total cover blocks the unreadable portion. This informational detection does not require ordinary visual sight of the effect.
operational.effect: For each qualifying effect, privately receive its readable local location/footprint, actual effect/spell/property identity when explicitly established and unprotected (otherwise its established broad magical category), and recorded readable proximate generating source. Undefined/protected identity and provenance fields independently report Indeterminate, without erasing other readable fields. Proximate source means the specific originating spell cast/caster identity, item producing an active property, creature/feature producing an aura, or site/zone/ritual generating that effect. A locally qualifying effect can disclose its recorded source identity even when that source is now beyond 60 feet, but not that source’s current remote location, condition or inventory. Record source identity as it actually exists; a missing personal name is not invented. A footprint is clipped to the readable area, rather than exposing the entire remote extent of a partially local effect.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Active intrinsic magic requires an actual presently active magical effect/aura record; a creature’s species/theme or RP pool alone is not one. A permanent item qualifies through a currently active property/effect, not a dormant historical enchantment with no active record. An existing ongoing record that is suppressed remains detectable as suppressed if that state is readable; an ended/removed effect or mere extinguished residue does not qualify. Resonance Tracking separately governs one-hour spell traces. A copy is identified as the actual copied effect and its proximate copying source, not a fresh original cast. Readable explicitly recorded provenance may identify the immediate source relationship but grants no independent recursive search through upstream controllers or histories. An attached aura can reveal its creature’s location through ordinary inference without granting sight of that body. Actual subject information protections can withhold attached-magic details, while independent environmental magic remains separately readable. No universal spell-rank/slot/charge/RP total, recipe, full stat block, dispel, control, extraction, copied spell, remote attack/casting origin or permanent map is granted. Remembering or writing a permitted snapshot uses ordinary memory and tools. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and all magical effects and their sources within 60 feet. CONFLICT RULING: Self with a 60-foot same-plane/line-of-effect sensing radius. NEW: local readable footprint, effect identity/category and proximate provenance, non-solid concealment bypass, actual ongoing suppressed versus ended/dormant distinctions and no direct remote-current-location report.

sourceCatalogRecord.name: Charm Person

operational.targets: One living person you can perceive within range
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Charmed condition toward you and regards you as friendly for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and the first time each round you or your allies damage it, it repeats the Wisdom save; success ends the spell. On the initial save success, no effect.
operational.effect: Charm one person so it temporarily regards you as friendly. Charmed does not grant command authority, compel beliefs, reveal secrets, or force the target to obey requests.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: A player-controlled target retains full agency over choices and beliefs. The spell cannot force self-harm, confession, permanent allegiance, transfer of possessions, or actions beyond the CoreV2 Charmed restrictions. A creature that cannot be Charmed is unaffected. Only the first damage event each round grants the additional repeat save. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained; F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Core lists Instantaneous duration, which conflicts with 'regards caster as friendly' and 'save ends early.' Concentration up to 1 minute and repeat-save cadence are NEW provisional operational decisions. Two source school placements are preserved externally; this record does not choose class access.

sourceCatalogRecord.name: Pacify

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect and presently treat as an enemy using ordinary information; this declaration reveals no hidden hostility.
operational.duration: One target round, no concentration. Ends at the target's first future regular-turn END, excluding the entire current target turn if already underway. Outside initiative, the deadline is six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; end-phase effects precede cleanup.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new restriction. Failure: it cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or begin/cast a spell whose selected mode includes a damage-dealing payload during the duration.
operational.effect: The prohibition applies across Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and other actual attack/cast permissions. A spell with multiple modes can be cast through a genuinely nondamaging mode. Deliberately established delayed or ongoing damage from that selected cast counts; a miss, successful victim save, immunity or hoped-for zero damage does not turn a damage payload into a nondamaging mode. Existing attacks/spells whose commitments already occurred are not undone or stopped retroactively by this application. The creature retains movement, interactions, non-damaging spells/control and other legal choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: This is not a blanket ban on every harmful nonattack technique and does not forbid harm merely because it is harmful: use the printed attack/damaging-spell categories. Truly involuntary acts retain their separate rules. No harm-ending clause is added; being attacked does not remove Pacify. This limited prohibition does not consume the whole-Action hard-control allowance merely because the creature lacks attractive alternatives. One Pacify restriction per caster/target; later failed save refreshes it, successful save does not remove it; independent other-caster records keep their own deadlines. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, enemy cannot attack or cast damaging spells for1round. NEW: WIS save, ordinary enemy designation and voluntary initiation/selected-damage-mode scope. Damage capability is determined from the selected effect, not a future hit or HP-loss prediction.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.

operational.resolution: At a creature’s first eligible exposure to this application, a willing creature may accept automatically; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. This is one application-specific acceptance/save decision, not a generic waiver of other spells’ saves. A successful save makes it unaffected by this cast for the rest of this cast, even on re-entry. Acceptance or failure creates this cast’s calm record. Geometrically present creatures behind total cover are not yet exposed; later exposure counts as their first eligible entry. Existing results are never rerolled merely because of leaving/re-entering, temporary cover, changed willingness or a new emotional trigger.
operational.effect: While its accepted/failed-save record is exposed, ordinary intense emotion such as panic, uncontrolled anger, grief or euphoria is subdued, and the mechanical effects of its actual Frightened condition records are suppressed. Mooncursed, Momentum Rampage, Divine Fury, Fury of the Host and Beast Empathy do not acquire such a dependency here. Their actual separate Frightened riders can be suppressed on affected recipients. Beliefs, memories, grievances, allegiances, judgment and agency remain; this spell does not impose indifference, prevent attacks, end combat, heal resources or repair oaths. Harm is not an additional ending trigger. Independent calm zones retain separate histories and concentration; their identical calming/suppression does not stack numerical magnitude. operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect; speak one word in a language you know. Actual hearing/understanding and hidden impossibility/prohibited conduct are resolved after payment, not through a free targeting oracle.
operational.duration: One commanded regular turn, no concentration; ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding the current turn if underway. Extra turns do not execute the order. Outside initiative, resolve one ordinary behavior opportunity within6elapsed seconds; establish initiative if combat timing matters.
operational.resolution: If it cannot hear/understand the word, no command applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new command. Failure: it must perform a legal bounded interpretation on its next regular turn, using only its actual existing permissions. An impossible or prohibited command creates no behavior; no replacement word is chosen. Reserve the shared hard-control allowance when establishing any actual whole-Action/turn component. If blocked, only independently satisfiable non-hard movement/interaction portions may apply; do not invent another command.
operational.effect: After ordinary start-phase events, obey before contradictory voluntary choices. Approach: spend ordinary available movement toward you by a safe legal route, stopping on reaching an adjacent legal space or exhausting safe meaningful progress. Flee: spend ordinary available movement away by a safe legal route. Neither forces Dash or grants movement. Drop: ordinarily release one releasable held object chosen by the target/controller, using its actual ordinary release permission; ownership never transfers and normal later recovery remains possible. Halt: refrain from voluntary movement for that turn, without imposing Speed0 or preventing actual involuntary transport. Grovel: become/remain Prone for that turn if capable, without automatically losing Actions or legal crawling. Other one-word commands may require at most one coherent ordinary action/movement/interaction within this same turn and the limitations below; the word never grants an otherwise unavailable action or named condition. The target/controller chooses lawful details, safe route and object where the word leaves choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No compelled attack/knowingly harmful act, direct self-harm, known serious hazard, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent surrender/ownership transfer, knowing binding-oath/duty violation, spell or optional limited-resource expenditure. If circumstances make the commanded behavior prohibited or impossible before execution, that portion fails rather than rewriting the word or extending the deadline. One pending Command application per target across casters; a later legally established failed-save application replaces it. No restoration of an older replaced command or spent hard-control allowance. A saved-against/wholly invalid new command creates no replacement. Simultaneous unresolved decisions use ordinary initiative order, else a fixed neutral order, never a caster’s after-the-fact preference. Unaffected Actions/BA/Reactions and movement remain; one-time Drop/Approach/Flee instructions finish once satisfied, while Halt/Grovel persist for the affected turn. Compelled movement uses the target’s movement and can provoke normal opportunity attacks. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, actual one-word compulsion for1round. NEW: WIS/hearing/language and bounded safe-command procedure. operational.targets: Choose a point you perceive with line of effect: within 60 feet for actual Enchantment casting access, or within 30 feet for actual Illusion casting access. Center a fixed 30-foot cube on that point, extending 15 feet along each axis. At resolution snapshot every creature physically in the cube with line of effect from its center that can actually see the pattern, including allies and yourself; no selective omission. The numeric range field records the maximum mode, not permission for Illusion to use 60 feet.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to one minute, with independent damage/rousing endings per affected creature. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. operational.resolution: Use the actual class’s school and rank-3/5-RP access. Enchantment access belongs to Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard and Paladin at their preserved levels; Monk’s actual mode is Illusion. Each eligible creature makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new components. Failure independently attempts Core Charmed toward you and actual Incapacitated. Charmed immunity blocks only Charmed; the Incapacitated component has its own defenses and shared hard-control allowance. A blocked hard component can leave independently legal Charmed. Apply the NEW spell-specific atomic initial batch in the shared rank-three manuscript: snapshot eligibility, resolve saves and legal components, apply every target’s components/immediate consequences, then process queued teardown of this Pattern if your own Incapacitated ended its concentration. Do not abort later targets because of iteration order.
operational.effect: Actual Charmed and Incapacitated retain their separate printed effects. Incapacitated ends applicable existing concentration and denies its ordinary covered action types; it does not inherently set Speed to 0. If self-Incapacitated ends your Pattern, other targets still receive that same initial batch and its real immediate consequences before this cast’s maintained components are removed. The visible lights remain in the fixed cube while concentration lasts but grant no general illumination, concealment or sight through obscurity. This is an initial snapshot: later entrants or initially ineligible creatures do not receive new applications. Later loss of sight does not end an existing application. End both still-present components from this cast on a creature when it receives positive post-defense/pre-temp-HP damage, or when another creature within physical reach uses an Action to rouse one selected Pattern application. Damage resolution preserves already-established hit/critical outcomes. No repeat saves.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: A fully prevented zero damage packet does not wake; a positive packet can wake even when temporary HP or an HP floor prevents ordinary HP loss. Recasts create independent sources subject to actual concentration transitions and each new hard-component check; an exact multiple-concentration feature does not convert them into refreshes. Ordinary darkness/obscurity can prevent initial actual sight even though the pattern itself is visible. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

sourceCatalogRecord.name: Suggestion

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. State one reasonable finite course of conduct in ordinary language before the save; actual hearing, understanding, hidden reasonableness and prohibitions are resolved after paid commitment.
operational.duration: Up to eight elapsed hours, no concentration. Ends earlier on task completion, actual removal, or when the remaining task becomes materially unreasonable, prohibited or no longer reasonably achievable in its established scope. A single identifiable conditional trigger may be awaited within the same original eight-hour deadline; no expiry reset on initiative, plane or circumstance changes.
operational.resolution: If the target cannot hear/understand or the instruction is invalid, establish nothing and choose no substitute task. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new compulsion. Failure: establish the legal finite task. If that defined task necessarily requires any whole ordinary Actions, even after a future conditional trigger, establish/claim its hard-control component once now. If blocked, only an independently meaningful compliant soft task achievable with legal movement/interactions may establish. A genuinely established soft remainder can replace a prior Suggestion; a wholly invalid, saved-against or wholly blocked attempt cannot. One active Suggestion per target across casters; a later established task replaces the older without restoring it or refunding hard history.
operational.effect: The target genuinely pursues the established reasonable task using only its existing ordinary movement, Action and interaction permissions. Examples include ordinary travel, finite work, waiting/guarding, delivering/retrieving an ordinary item, speaking or meeting someone. An ordinary hostile act is possible only when actually reasonable given its existing beliefs, loyalties, knowledge and circumstances; the caster gains no diagnostic of those facts. Legal route, method and unspecified details remain target/controller choices. The persistent instruction’s priority timestamp is successful establishment and it uses shared Compelled Budget Arbitration at each relevant opportunity. Outside initiative use ordinary elapsed work/travel; when combat timing matters, establish ordinary initiative and existing budgets. No repeating virtual control cycle or additional Actions is granted.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No indefinite obey-me relationship, direct self-harm, knowingly serious hazard, unreasonable betrayal/murder of a recognized ally, compelled spellcasting/RP, consumables/charges/limited-use resources, protected/private secrets, permanent surrender of materially valuable property or knowing binding-oath/duty violation. Reasonable ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks and normal required ammunition within actual limits; optional finite riders and special finite-feature ammunition remain forbidden. A task established without a hard component never acquires one later. If new obstacles would necessarily require an unreserved whole Action, use an achievable legal alternative within its original soft scope or end the remaining compulsion. Mere delay/inconvenience or a temporary obstruction does not end a still-reasonable achievable finite task. No repeat save or separate harm-ending clause is added; new violence/facts may instead make remaining conduct unreasonable. Bonus Actions, Reactions and separately granted extra Actions are not commandeered. No hidden future information or new communication ability is supplied. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, actual reasonable-suggestion compulsion for up to eight hours; effect overrides Instantaneous placeholder. NEW: WIS, hearing/language, no concentration, finite task/conditional trigger, actual reasonableness/resource/conduct limits, establishment-time hard reservation, same-spell replacement and persistent arbitration timestamp. Stronger than Minor Suggestion’s optional nudge; high-impact duration/control remains an explicit human-balance concern.

operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, one perceived creature within 120 feet and line of effect, and a Wisdom save negating the effect. NEW choose a temporary True Neutral effective-alignment overlay, not absence of alignment, general predicate suppression or a new moral classification. On a failed binary save and absent an actual applicable immunity, establish concentration for at most 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Ordinary natural 1/20 do not shift the save. Charmed-only immunity does not stop a spell that imposes no Charmed condition; a genuine broader or alignment-alteration immunity keeps its actual scope. No repeat application/ending save or daily immunity is invented.

NEW explicit undefined-record boundary: this overlay requires both real defined canonical mechanical axes; a genuinely unaligned/no-record creature or a record with an undefined axis is not converted into fabricated Neutral data. Hidden target alignment need not be known by the caster: the ordinary perceived-creature cast commits and resolves its save without a free alignment preflight; missing/undefined qualification creates no overlay and no diagnostic alignment disclosure/refund. An already True Neutral creature with both defined axes can still receive the overlay after a failed save; it can cover later independent changes while live. The lawful underlying record is never overwritten.

Use Neutral/Neutral as effective alignment for rules whose actual predicate queries current effective canonical alignment, including genuine source-qualified alignment damage/detection/item/spell requirements. Rules requiring underlying/permanent identity, actual conduct, earned lineage, acquisition snapshots or independently recorded tags continue to require those facts. There is no new feat/class/spell/item acquisition, loss, healing, RP refill, oathbreak, atonement waiver, forced belief, loyalty, command, Charm or hard-control grant. A live power rechecking effective alignment may cease/resume only under its own dependency rule; a completed independent effect is not generically undone or recast. The underlying source and used allowances survive.

NEW named exception AP-AS-01 to reviewed Alignment Suggestion, not a claim that the old card already excluded Purge: while an actual unsuppressed Purge operates, evaluate its two Neutral values after Suggestion's live fixed changed-axis values, regardless of their cast order. Purge does not delete Suggestion, stop its concentration, extend its own source deadline or alter its source rank. When casting a new Suggestion on this recipient, compute the target baseline with every previous Suggestion overlay AND every Purge overlay on that target excluded, retaining all other actually authorized underlying changes and independent effects. Snapshot the Suggestion caster's own current effective orientation normally, including a genuine Purge on the caster if present. Compute the existing one-step shifts; only genuinely changed defined axes gain fixed Suggestion values. Its no-changed-axis/no-new-replacement rule remains. Thus Purge cannot become a target-side staircase, yet a Purged caster really has Neutral/Neutral for the existing caster-side snapshot.

Independent changes remain below the overlays with their real timestamps; ending Purge exposes the current live Suggestion/underlying result, not a restored old snapshot. Ending Suggestion while Purge remains exposes only what Purge still covers. Suppression of Purge temporarily exposes the other currently lawful result while the original deadline continues; no replay, refund or new application results on resumption. One Purge-family application per target across casters: a new failed-save eligible application replaces the prior record and its unused duration, not two stacked shifts. A saved-against/countered/no-eligible-record application does not itself replace another valid record; ordinary cast-start concentration displacement is separate and is never reversed. Expiry, dispel, caster death/incapacity or loss of required concentration ends this application. An unnamed future alignment effect still needs its own actual interaction; this one named exception creates no universal priority taxonomy and interprets no cosmology.
workedCases: DI7-07-A: A paid legal cast atDC17 receives target WIS16 and two defined axes; absent actual immunity it establishes Neutral/Neutral for a concentration60 seconds. An applicable current-effective predicate reads those values. Acquired oath, class, views, conduct and ability opportunities remain unchanged. WIS17 negates with cost kept. Hidden undefined axes are not fabricated as Neutral and their absence is not disclosed by free preflight.

DI7-07-B: Target baseline is Lawful Good; another caster first establishes a Suggestion toward Chaotic Evil, recording fixed Neutral/Neutral. Purge from a separate caster then covers it. A new Good-oriented Suggestion target baseline excludes both older Suggestion and Purge; a Lawful Good caster finds no changed axes and creates no replacement. Later genuine underlying Neutral Evil change survives. End Purge while older Suggestion remains: its fixed Neutral/Neutral still applies. End that Suggestion: the lawful underlying Neutral Evil appears, not the old Lawful Good snapshot. Separate casters/actual concentration permissions are required for the fixture.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Under the NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01 exception, also exclude all Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor overlays on this target when computing this baseline. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still supplies Neutral/Neutral, subject to that caster's own active AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshot for the final effective read. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed; an eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot applies last under AC4-ALIGN-01, without deleting, pausing or refreshing these lower records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
operational.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step. NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: effective-alignment reads evaluate this live Suggestion overlay and the reviewed AP-AS-01 Purge interaction first, then apply the eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot last. Lock/Anchor ending or inactivity exposes the then-live lower result with its original history/deadline; no ended overlay is restored. This adds no general alignment priority system.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, WIS, concentration minute and actual push toward caster alignment. NEW: temporary canonical one-step overlay on both eligible axes. Exact-review proposals: compute without previous same-spell overlay to prevent recast ratcheting, overlay only genuinely changed axes, fixed values, and no new application when no defined axis changes; independent base changes survive ending.

completeCurrentAuthoredRecord.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes a CHA save. NEW: a willing creature can elect failure before the roll. Success causes no application; failure establishes a nonconcentration lock lasting 24 elapsed hours. Record each currently defined effective canonical alignment axis; undefined axes remain undefined and unprotected. While operative, the lock prevents a recorded effective value from being replaced by a different one. It neither reveals values nor compels conduct. Underlying progression, Corrupted and other independent records continue to change and remain recorded, but a locked axis exposes its fixed value to mechanical alignment queries until the lock ends. Display-only masks retain their own rules and do not become actual state changes. NEW: use the earliest active eligible lock for each axis; later conflicting applications retain their own snapshots and deadlines but are suppressed for that axis. Ending exposes the current underlying state without restoring an old baseline or erasing another source’s record. Suppression retains the clock and can expose underlying changes without replaying them when the lock resumes. A prevented transition does not refund a paid cost or queue a later free attempt. Explicit absolute-source exceptions and information protections retain their scope. This grants no moral judgment, oath override or personality restriction.

CURRENT INTERFACE — NEW scoped exception `AC4-ALIGN-01` for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor versus reviewed Alignment Purge/Suggestion. A Lock/Anchor application freezes only the effective defined axis value it actually snapshots; it does not delete, prevent creation of, pause, refund, or rewrite an underlying Alignment Suggestion, Alignment Purge, or independent lawful alignment record. For effective-alignment reads on a locked axis, evaluate the ordinary underlying history and reviewed Suggestion/Purge interaction (including AP-AS-01) first, then apply the active Lock/Anchor snapshot last. Thus a Purge or Suggestion cast after a lock can establish its own live record and pay/keep its own costs and clock, but cannot change the locked effective axis while that lock remains active. When a new Suggestion computes its target baseline, exclude prior Suggestion overlays and Purge overlays as AP-AS-01 already requires, and additionally exclude AC4 Lock/Anchor overlays on the target so the lock cannot become a ratchet staircase. A Purge on the Suggestion caster still affects that caster's own effective orientation normally. If Lock/Anchor is applied while Purge or Suggestion is already effective, it snapshots the currently effective defined value; later ending/suppression of the lower overlay does not alter that snapshot. When Lock/Anchor ends or is inactive because a zone was exited/suppressed, the then-live lower lawful result becomes effective immediately with its original deadline/history; no old snapshot is restored and no missed application replays. Undefined axes are never fabricated.

historicalWorkedCases: A locked axis stays at its recorded effective value while an independent underlying change is retained. Expiry exposes that current underlying record.
An undefined axis is not assigned Neutral. An observer does not automatically learn a hidden locked value.

questionDispositions.reason: A generated isolated extraplanar spell-cell preserves the printed temporary-other-plane effect without naming or identifying any reviewed plane. The draft topology is retained only as a local spell-space and revised to an elastic finite enclosure so body/atomic geometry changes do not require a hidden preemptive interrupt.

Use Action/60 ft/V-S-F/base 7 RP and actual class spell DC; NEW CHA save, willing pre-roll failure, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, one-live-application guard, and the existing shared hard-control allowance. Concentration begins at legal cast commitment and a failed/countered cast does not restore displaced concentration.

Use finite BAN-CLOSE-03. No pre-change early-return interrupt exists. Mandatory source events resolve normally. When Banishment ends, remaining identities are moved to the snapshotted origin plane despite a narrow terminal endpoint-blocker exception, then physical fitting is resolved by the already accepted canonical placement procedure. An unresolved physical placement conflict is an origin-plane state, not continuing exile.

Independently legal visitors and internally created creatures retain their own real permissions/costs. Their source must target a currently fitting, perceived in-cell footprint; Banishment cannot expand first to create target legality. At closure, all remaining real identities are returned once in stable order and handed to canonical placement; ended/escaped/consumed identities are not recreated.

The spell transports exactly the selected creature plus genuine noncreature worn/carried gear. Separate creature bodies—including passengers, mounts, swallowed creatures and companions—do not become gear. Impossible separation/tethers can defeat establishment. Transformations, death, body removal, Null Disabled summons and cargo keep their own source lifecycles.

Use accepted AC4 interfaces: rank-4 Banishment is ineligible for Spell Shield; Dimensional Anchor blocks ordinary planar endpoints; Resonance Beacon remains same-plane; Xi can end only the actual ongoing target branch with its exact consent/perception/range/charge procedure. Cleric Banish Unholy remains a different class technique.

Keep Paladin cards exact. NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 classifies this spell only as planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape blocks only voluntarily accepted Banishment because it expressly includes voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute does not block Banishment because it names only teleportation/invisibility; Reign of Ashes does not block because it denies benefit from Dash/teleportation. A pre-save acceptance flag determines voluntary versus forced admission whether the target elects failure or rolls.

BAN-ADMIT-03 allows a visitor/created body only through its own real destination/creation permission, cost and a fitting currently perceived in-cell footprint. No expansion can supply prior target perception/LoE. After legal establishment the cell may expand only for clearance. Admission grants no route, knowledge, immunity or return resource.

No universal interrupt or rewind is created. Mandatory transformations/death/expiry complete under their actual source. Cell geometry expands after mandatory in-cell anatomy changes as needed. Final Banishment ending uses BAN-CLOSE-03 and canonical placement-conflict handling on the origin plane; no future ruling is needed for ordinary collapse/filled-space cases.

Accepted AC4 procedures are interoperability authority only within their recorded scope; lexical class hits are navigation evidence only. Preserve all historical scenario text as evidence, author current adjudications separately, and claim no runtime/human/balance approval.

castAndSave.save: NEW BAN-SAVE-01: target makes a Charisma save against the actual casting-class spell DC. Before rolling, target records admissionIntent = ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT may either elect automatic failure or roll normally; if it rolls and fails, establishment is still voluntary. RESIST plus failed save is involuntary. Actual save bonuses/defenses apply, including Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment. Success creates no cell and no exile.
castAndSave.hardControl: On a failed save, establishment is one hard encounter-removal component under the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance. If that allowance cannot be claimed, no exile/cell is established and no soft fallback is invented. The paid cast remains spent.
castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

currentInterfaces.spellShield: Banishment is generating rank 4 and therefore does not satisfy accepted Spell Shield rank 0–3 eligibility, regardless of discounts.
currentInterfaces.dimensionalAnchor: At establishment, Dimensional Anchor applies under its accepted endpoint rule and can defeat the planar transition. During voluntary escape it applies normally. At BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal ending, the mandatory-plane-return step uses only the narrowly scoped endpointBlockerException; physical fit is never ignored and is resolved afterward by BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03.
currentInterfaces.resonanceBeacon: Beacon requires same-plane traveler/beacon. A Beacon outside the cell does not become same-plane. A Beacon created inside obeys its actual rules but does not create an outside destination.
currentInterfaces.xi: Xi Declare Contradiction can end the ongoing Banishment creature-target branch only through its actual Action, 60-foot perception, known spell record, caster+target consent and charge procedure. Isolation may make those predicates unavailable; possession alone is not remote release.
currentInterfaces.fateBound: Actual Oracle Fate-Bound Boon IV grants its +2 against banishment saves; no generic Oracle immunity exists.
currentInterfaces.paladin: NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 applies only to ordinary Banishment: it is planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape (/cards/41) blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because it expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; it does not block RESIST+failed-save forced exile. Verdict Absolute (/cards/43) names only voluntary teleportation/invisibility, so it does not block either Banishment branch. currentInterfaces.cleric: Cleric Banish Unholy remains its own class card: WIS save, radiant damage/push and possible until-end-next-turn banishment rider. It does not borrow this ordinary spell's cell/save/duration.
currentInterfaces.nullSummons: A finite summoned body that is Null Disabled at 0 remains the same body while its source persists. Banishment does not heal/refresh it. Independent summon concentration/deadline/end remains real; if it ends in the cell, there is no body to eject.

transportClassification.rule: Ordinary Banishment is planar/extradimensional displacement. It is not teleportation. This classification exists only to adjudicate this spell against exact current predicates and does not redefine other planar effects.

paladinConsequences.No Escape: Blocks ACCEPT because the card expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; does not stop forced RESIST+failed-save exile.
paladinConsequences.Verdict Absolute: Does not block Banishment because its card forbids only voluntary teleportation/invisibility.
paladinConsequences.Reign of Ashes: Does not block Banishment because its card denies benefit from Dash/teleportation and Banishment is not teleportation.
